examples.title: Lyric replacement
examples.instruction: Replace “can't be tamed” with “are the same” in the lyrics.
examples.preservation: The melody, singing voice, and accompaniment.
examples.sourceLabel: AuK official demo · Vocal Edit · English
examples.origin: Official Vocal Edit sample vocaledit-en-2, input/output pair under AuK.
examples.instructionBasis: Official instruction and replacement markers. Only the changed lyric fragment is reproduced.
examples.taxonomyBasis: Changing sung words is Semantic editing under the survey taxonomy.

examples.title: Instrument replacement
examples.instruction: Replace the French horn with a clarinet.
examples.preservation: The musical phrase and sounds outside the target instrument.
examples.sourceLabel: Audio-Omni official demo · Style Transfer · Example 3
examples.origin: Official Style Transfer sample 1920. result.wav is the model output; gt.wav is not used.
examples.instructionBasis: Paraphrase of the official request to change playing French horn to playing clarinet.
examples.taxonomyBasis: Changing the instrument/source is Instance editing, although the source page calls the task Style Transfer.

examples.title: Sound addition
examples.instruction: Add skateboarding sounds to the recording.
examples.preservation: The sounds already present in the recording.
examples.origin: Official Adding sample 22. result.wav is the model output; gt.mp3 is not used.
examples.instructionBasis: Paraphrase of the official skateboarding addition prompt.
examples.taxonomyBasis: Adding an identifiable sound event is Instance editing.

examples.title: Sound removal
examples.preservation: All sounds other than the target fan.
examples.origin: Official Removing sample 1226. result.wav is the model output; gt.wav is not used.
examples.instructionBasis: Paraphrase of the official running-electric-fan removal prompt.
examples.taxonomyBasis: Removing an identifiable sound source is Instance editing.

preservationNote: Preservation fields describe the goal of each edit, not a measured claim of perfect preservation.
mediaPolicy: Official recordings stream from their authors' project pages, with source attribution. No official recordings are redistributed locally.
